verdict.rationale: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore says agents built on it can call MCP servers, and that AgentCore handles authentication and access control for those connections. That is a first-party capability for connecting agents to MCP tools, but the evidence is a single marketing mention. The awslabs MCP servers are the server side and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented steps for registering or configuring external MCP servers, details of tool discovery and invocation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Your agent needs to call an MCP server, a knowledge base, an internal API, and a Lambda function in the same turn, and every connection needs to know who's calling and whether they're allowed. AgentCore helps you handle the authentication and access control
